verdict.rationale: Ollama's own REST API runs and manages models, and a hands-on community report confirms you can hotswap models without restarting the server. First-party evidence of multi-model loading is thin: the 'Run multiple models concurrently' claim appears on the pricing page and is not documented as a local-server behavior, and the vendor's own 'switch models' line is agent-workflow marketing. missing for 10: first-party docs describing on-demand model loading/unloading and switching within a running local server, documented limits on concurrently loaded models and memory, corroboration beyond a single community anecdote.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server
